sectionReplaces.heading: # DEPLOYMENT STATE
sectionReplaces.content:
- Hosting: GitHub Pages, Jekyll, baseurl /english.
- Latest verified implementation commit: b09f75c (Batch 14 closing commit: inbound internal links from 4 rental guides + comparison cross-links added to the 3 verified-data guides; articles published in part-commits 789fe6a/a36d06d/a04221b/6b7e8f6 - 10 model reviews, 10 model comparisons, 3 choosing guides, 2 spec explainers). Verified 2026-09-23: Quality Gate run 35874723441 (commit b09f75c, success, all steps) and Pages build-and-deployment run 35874723270 (success, all steps); the quality steps of the part-commit gates on 789fe6a, a36d06d, a04221b and 6b7e8f6 all passed; the live /articles/ index renders the 592-guide total, the /topics/motorcycles/ hub renders the 25-guide count, and 16 of the 25 new batch-14 article pages spot-checked live resolve with correct content.
- Docs-sync state commit: 93d7d5c (github-actions bot, 2026-09-23) merged the 25 batch-14 rows into docs/matrix/master-matrix.csv and applied the README/MASTER-MATRIX/MODEL-DATABASE batch-14 state updates server-side, including repair of baked-in mojibake in docs/MASTER-MATRIX.md (73 sequences) and docs/MODEL-DATABASE.md (75 sequences). Diagnostics of the sync run are preserved in sync-debug.txt.
- Batch-13 state for reference: 567 articles, final implementation commit 6e37433, gate run 35871816160, Pages run 35871855319 (see docs/matrix/batch-13-status.md).
- README-only state updates may create a newer HEAD than the SHAs recorded here; the values above always refer to the last implementation commit whose CI/deploy was actually verified. Matrix-row and README merges run server-side via the Docs Sync workflow (scripts/apply-batch-14b-docs.js, payloads docs/sync/*.json).
